title: Hash Map Lookup
intuition: Use a hash table to record element indexes or frequencies, enabling O(1) checks during array traversals.
recognition_signals: Frequent search queries on unsorted arrays
step_by_step_strategy: For each element, calculate needed target partner or check frequency.
If matched, return result; else record element in map.
common_mistakes: Overwriting values before checks are completed
